sql:
SELECT
  ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, [1, 2, 3]) AS bucket,
  ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, [1, 2, 3], TRUE) AS bucket_without_boundaries,
  ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, [1, 2, 3], FALSE, "bucket_ranges") AS bucket_ranges,
  ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, [1, 2, 3], FALSE, "bucket_ranges_json") AS bucket_ranges_json
shape: SELECT ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, ARRAY[1, 2, 3]) AS bucket, ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, ARRAY[1, 2, 3], TRUE) AS bucket_without_boundaries, ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, ARRAY[1, 2, 3], FALSE, 'bucket_ranges') AS bucket_ranges, ML.BUCKETIZE(2.5, ARRAY[1, 2, 3], FALSE, 'bucket_ranges_json') AS bucket_ranges_json;
